name: Fordham University / The Ailey School — BFA in Dance
applicationSystem: Common App (Fordham) + Ailey School dance application

fit.note: Ailey = modern/Horton/ballet powerhouse; concert-focused, not commercial.

rounds.label: Early Action / Priority Performance

academicDeadline.note: Ailey/Fordham apply page: "Applications open August 1 for fall 2027 enrollment"; "Dance Application for The Ailey School and Common Application for Fordham University are due" Nov 1, 2026 — confirms both apps share one deadline (corrects prior placeholder value of Jan 1).

artsSupplementDeadline.note: Ailey dance application due Nov 1, 2026 (single early deadline; no later RD route into the BFA) — confirmed for fall 2027 enrollment.

decisionRelease.note: Ailey/Fordham apply page: "Prospective students will receive a notification of their admission decision from Fordham University in March 2027." Page gives month only, not an exact day.

rounds.notes: Both the Fordham academic app (Common App) and the Ailey dance application are due Nov 1, 2026 — confirmed via the Ailey/Fordham apply page for fall 2027 enrollment.

fee.note: "$45 audition fee"; "Applicants invited to audition are required to submit the audition fee to secure their spot" (paid after invitation, not at dance-application submission). Separate from the program's $280/year Ailey physical therapy fee (see costs.totalCostOfAttendance note).

deadline.note: Dance application due Nov 1, 2026; functions as the prescreen (director reviews, then invites).

prescreenRequired.note: Ailey/Fordham apply page: "Applicants who show the highest potential will be invited to audition" — invitation-only after dance-application review.

videoSpec.note: No technical video spec published. Page confirms in-person audition is required for domestic applicants; international applicants may submit a video audition instead ("applicants may audition by video") — no format/length/repertoire spec given.

auditions.label: In-person audition — NYC or tour city

date.note: Invited applicants audition Jan/Feb/Mar; specific 2027 dates publish in fall (Ailey side).

auditions.notes: Invitation-only after Dec 1. Directly clusters with Tisch/Pace/Purchase for a single NYC trip.

testPolicy.note: Fordham standing test-optional policy — verify for Fall 2027. NOT re-verified 2026-08-11: fordham.edu redirects to a CAS login gateway (loginp.fordham.edu) for every page on this domain and refuses anonymous fetches — needs a manual browser spot-check.

recommendations.value: One school-counselor recommendation via the Common Application (for Fordham); no additional recommendation specified for the Ailey dance application.
recommendations.note: Ailey/Fordham apply page: a "recommendation from a school counselor" is required for first-year applicants through the Common Application.

value.prompt: Common App personal essay, submitted to Fordham University.
Ailey School dance application essay discussing the applicant's professional goals.

essays.note: Ailey/Fordham apply page confirms an essay to Fordham plus "an essay discussing the applicant's professional goals" to The Ailey School's BFA Dance Application. Exact Fordham/Common App prompt text and any word limits not published on this page — verify on Common App.

interview.value: No separate interview stated; applicants are screened from their submitted dance application and, if selected, invited directly to audition.

scholarships.name: Fordham merit scholarships
scholarships.notes: Fordham academic merit; Ailey talent consideration via audition. Ailey/Fordham apply page (2026-08-11) confirms "merit-based awards on artistic and academic potential" plus need-based aid through Fordham, but publishes no specific amounts or a separate scholarship application/deadline.

fafsaRequired.note: Ailey/Fordham apply page: financial aid applicants must "file the CSS Profile and the FAFSA application."

cssProfileRequired.note: Ailey/Fordham apply page: financial aid applicants must "file the CSS Profile and the FAFSA application." No CSS Profile code published on this page (see cssCode below — unverified this session).

tuitionAnnual.note: Ailey/Fordham apply page: "Students attending the Ailey/Fordham BFA in Dance program pay tuition directly to Fordham University" — no dollar figure on this page; page directs applicants to Fordham's site for cost details. Fordham's own tuition/cost pages (fordham.edu) were bot-blocked this session (CAS login redirect loop) — needs a manual browser check.

totalCostOfAttendance.note: Ailey/Fordham apply page notes an additional "annual physical therapy fee of $280" charged by Ailey on top of Fordham tuition/fees (Fordham cost-of-attendance figure itself unverified — see tuitionAnnual note).

companyAffiliation.value: Alvin Ailey American Dance Theater / Ailey II

notable.value: Joint BFA with The Ailey School — premier modern/Ailey training in NYC.
